<script setup lang="ts">
import { useDialog, type UseDialogProps, type UseDialogEmits } from "./use-dialog";
import { DialogProvider } from "./use-dialog-context";

const props = defineProps<UseDialogProps>();
const emit = defineEmits<UseDialogEmits>();

const api = useDialog(props, emit);
DialogProvider(api);
</script>

<template>
  <slot />
</template>

import { createContext } from "../../hooks/create-context"
import type { dialogConnect } from "@/lib/utils"
import type { ComputedRef } from "vue"

export type DialogContext = ComputedRef<ReturnType<typeof dialogConnect>>

export const [DialogProvider, useDialogContext] = createContext<DialogContext>({
    id: "DialogContext",
    providerName: "<Dialog />",
})
